message.content:
**Paris Get‑away Planner – 7 Days & Nights**

> *“A city where art lives on its walls, romance hangs in the air, and baguettes taste better than your dreams.”*  
> — Anonymous

Below you’ll find a ready‑to‑go itinerary that balances iconic sights, local experiences, culinary delights, practical logistics, and a touch of “off‑the‑beaten‑path” magic. Feel free to tweak it based on your interests or flight windows!

---

## ✈️ Pre‑Trip Checklist  

| Item | Why It Matters |
|------|----------------|
| **Passport + Visa** | EU/US citizens usually don’t need visas; check French consulate site for updates. |
| **Travel Insurance** | Covers health emergencies, cancellations, lost luggage. |
| **Currency** | €1 000–€2 500 total (mid‑range) covers meals, tickets, souvenirs. Use contactless cards wherever possible. |
| **Packing List** | Light layers, comfortable walking shoes, universal adapter, small umbrella, reusable water bottle. |
| **Apps** | Google Maps, Citymapper, RATP (metro), Moovit, TripAdvisor, Yelp, Duolingo (basic French). |

---

## 🗓 Day‑by‑Day Breakdown  

### Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 12:00 PM | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle / Orly → take RER B to Gare du Nord → metro to hotel | Book a short‑term rental near Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près or Le Marais for easy access. |
| 02:30 PM | Check‑in & quick snack | Grab croissants from **Poilâne** (Saint‑Germain). |
| 04:00 PM | Stroll along Rue des Martyrs | Discover cafés, patisseries, vintage shops. |
| 07:00 PM | Dinner | Try **Le Comptoir du Relais** (French bistro fare). Reserve early! |
| 09:00 PM | Night walk over Pont Neuf | Sunset view of Seine, perfect first photo op. |

#### Budget Snapshot (Day 1)
| Category | Approx (€) |
|----------|------------|
| Hotel (Mid‑Range) | 120 |
| Meals | 60 |
| Transport (RER+Metro) | 15 |
| Miscellaneous | 10 |
| **Total** | ~205 |

---

### Day 2 – Classic Icons  
| Time | Attraction | Tips |
|------|-----------|------|
| 08:30 AM | Eiffel Tower | Buy skip‑line ticket online (~25 €, includes elevator). |
| 11:00 AM | Trocadéro Gardens | Great photo spot—no crowds yet. |
| 01:00 PM | Lunch at **Café Constant** | Small plates, classic French cuisine. |
| 03:00 PM | Musée d’Orsay | Focus on Impressionism; buy combined ticket with Louvre (~20 €. ) |
| 06:00 PM | Walk through Jardin des Tuileries | Relax before dinner. |
| 07:45 PM | Dinner at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** | Michelin star experience; book months ahead. |
| 09:30 PM | Evening cruise on the Seine | 90‑minute boat tour (~18 €). |

---

### Day 3 – Montmartre & Artistic Vibes  
| Time | Spot | Highlights |
|------|------|-------------|
| 09:00 AM | Sacré-Cœur Basilica | Free entry; panoramic views. |
| 10:30 AM | Place du Tertre | Artists selling works; try a portrait sketch. |
| 12:30 PM | Brunch at **La Maison Rose** | Iconic café, great Instagram backdrop. |
| 02:00 PM | Explore Pigalle & Moulin Rouge area | Not just nightlife—historic cabaret vibe. |
| 04:30 PM | Visit Espace Dalí | Surrealist masterpieces. |
| 07:00 PM | Dinner at **Le Consulat** | Traditional French dishes. |
| 09:00 PM | Optional jazz club (**New Morning**) | Live music until midnight. |

---

### Day 4 – Hidden Gems & Local Life  
| Time | Destination | What Makes It Special |
|------|--------------|------------------------|
| 09:00 AM | Canal Saint-Martin | Quaint canal-side boutiques, street art. |
| 11:00 AM | Marché Bastille (if Saturday) | Fresh produce, cheese stalls, lively atmosphere. |
| 01:00 PM | Picnic lunch | Pick up baguette, cheese, wine from nearby market. |
| 03:00 PM | Parc des Buttes-Chaumont | Less touristy park with waterfalls & temple. |
| 05:30 PM | Return to hotel | Rest & freshen up. |
| 07:30 PM | Dinner at **Septime** | Contemporary French tasting menu (reserve well!). |
| 10:00 PM | Late stroll around Latin Quarter | Poetic streets, student vibes. |

---

### Day 5 – Palace & Culture  
| Time | Site | Practical Info |
|------|------|---------------|
| 08:30 AM | Château de Versailles | Take RER C; pre-book guided audio tour (~35 €). |
| 12:30 PM | Lunch inside palace grounds | Café Royal offers light bites. |
| 02:30 PM | Continue exploring gardens & fountains | Rent a bike or pedal cart. |
| 05:30 PM | Back to Paris | Metro ride back. |
| 07:30 PM | Dinner at **Benoit** | Classic brasserie, affordable. |
| 09:30 PM | Attend a performance at Opéra Garnier | Tickets vary; consider balcony seats (~70 €). |

---

### Day 6 – Shopping & Farewell Feast  
| Time | Activity | Details |
|------|---------|---------|
| 09:00 AM | Galeries Lafayette & Printemps | Window shopping, rooftop terrace coffee. |
| 11:30 AM | Fashion district exploration | Avenue Montaigne, Champs‑Élysées. |
| 01:00 PM | Lunch at **Ladurée** | Macarons & tea service. |
| 03:00 PM | Last minute souvenir hunt | Look for artisanal soaps, perfume bottles. |
| 05:00 PM | Pack & relax | Enjoy a spa treatment at **Spa Nuxe** (optional). |
| 07:30 PM | Final dinner at **Restaurant Guy Savoy** | Three-Michelin-star experience (book 6 months prior). |
| 10:30 PM | Midnight walk across Pont Alexandre III | Stunning illuminated bridge. |

---

### Day 7 – Departure Prep  
| Task | Timing |
|------|--------|
| Breakfast at hotel | 08:00 AM |
| Checkout & store bags at concierge | 10:00 AM |
| Quick last‑min stroll to Notre-Dame area | 11:00 AM |
| Head to airport via RER/Bus | 12:30 PM |
| Flight departure | As scheduled |

---

## 💸 Cost Overview (Per Person)

| Expense | Estimate (€) |
|---------|--------------|
| Flights (roundtrip) | 350–700 |
| Accommodation (hotel/rental) | 900–1500 |
| Food & drinks | 600–800 |
| Attractions & tours | 250–400 |
| Transportation within Paris | 50–80 |
| Souvenirs & extras | 100–200 |
| **Grand Total** | **~2600–4400** |

*(Adjust according to luxury vs. budget choices.)*

---

## 📌 Insider Tips

| Topic | Recommendation |
|-------|----------------|
| **Best Season** | Spring (April–June) or fall (September–October); mild weather, fewer tourists. |
| **Transport Passes** | A 3‑day Navigo Week pass (€27) gives unlimited metro/RER rides. For longer stays, look into multi‑city passes. |
| **Dining Etiquette** | Waiters may not always open menus automatically; use “Je voudrais…”. Tip about 10% unless service charge already added. |
| **Language Basics** | Learn simple phrases (“Bonjour”, “Merci”, “Où est …?”). Most Parisians appreciate even minimal effort. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables secure; pickpocket hotspots: metro stations, major attractions. |
| **Connectivity** | Purchase a local SIM card (€10–15) or rent pocket Wi-Fi. |
| **Sustainability** | Opt for public transit, cycle rentals, refillable water bottle. Avoid single‑use plastic. |

---

## 🎒 Packing Essentials

| Category | Must‑Have Items |
|----------|-----------------|
| Clothing | Comfortable walking shoes, layered tops, lightweight jacket, dressy outfit for fine dining. |
| Tech | Phone charger, power bank, European plug adapters, headphones. |
| Documents | Passport, copies of reservations, insurance info, emergency contacts. |
| Toiletries | Travel‑size toiletries, sunscreen, lip balm. |
| Extras | Reusable tote bag, notebook, guidebook, small lock for lockers. |

---

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you'd like more detail on specific restaurants, alternative itineraries, or help booking tickets, let me know—I’m happy to dive deeper. Bon voyage! 🚀
